PHASE.NAME: RTK Streaming Runner and Raw Evidence
PHASE.GOAL: Move Synapse proxy execution closer to RTK runner behavior by streaming child stdout/stderr, teeing complete raw output into evidence artifacts, and exposing an optional CLI evidence hint without inflating normal filtered output.

STEPS.step-1: Replaced wait_with_output capture with streaming stdout/stderr readers that tee complete raw output into XDG data evidence files.
STEPS.step-2: Propagated raw evidence metadata through ProxyOutput while preserving filtered output and exit status behavior.
STEPS.step-3: Exposed syn proxy --evidence for explicit raw-output artifact hints.
STEPS.step-4: Rendered evidence path only when requested so normal token-saving output remains compact.
STEPS.step-5: Verified evidence files contain full raw output even when proxy output is filtered.
